balls.text: Manhas makes room and caves a full ball over point to finish the innings with a boundary

that was a quiet dismissal indeed! Shami fired this full on the stumps and Manhas drilled it down the pitch, Ashwin had set off and had to quickly turn around, Shami back flicked it to the stumps and Ashwin was short, there was barely an appeal and nor did the umpire raise the finger, Ashwin didn't wait and walked off, for a second we didn't know what was going on!
fuller ball and he drills it down the ground, Manhas did well to push for the second
slower ball and Ashwin clears the front leg and slogs it wide of midwicket
fuller ball and he makes room and places it wide of long-off, Duminy does really well to slide and cut it off
loses control of this and it's wide down the leg side
falls inches short of the rope, this was too short and wide outside off, Manhas hops and upper cuts it down to third man, a little more power and it would have gone all the way
Unadkat gets him with the slower ball, it was short and Jadeja swiveled and looked to pull it to fine leg, just shaved the face of the bat on the way to Karthik
this was pitched up outside off and he picked the length and slammed it over long-on

Agarwal nearly spilled that! Slower ball and short, Dhoni rocked back to pull and it was flat over square leg, Agarwal in the deep ran to his left and grabbed at it, it popped out and he tried taking it in the second attempt and it slipped out again but he managed in the third attempt
heads up Jaydev! That was smashed with such force and Unadkat did well to get his head out of the way, full ball and Dhoni made room and smashed that down the ground
fires this one full on the stumps and he flicks it to square leg
keeper up to the stumps, slower ball and he looks to slog and he mistimes it to long-on
another slower ball and shorter and he checks the pull to short fine leg
slower ball and he drills it down the track and wide of mid-on
short ball and a slower one, he softly pulls it to short fine leg
this is bad bowling, nobody patrolling the deep on the off side and he bowls it short and wide outside off, Dhoni airborne as he slaps it flat over deep point

Vijay's catching the skiers tonight, this was a length ball and Faf made room to clear long-on, he closed the face of the bat as he made contact and hence didn't hit it well enough, Vijay under it at long-on
clears the long boundary! This was short of a length and Faf was in position early for the pull, picked the length and clubbed it over deep midwicket
this time he fires it full on the stumps, Dhoni drives firmly wide of extra cover, the field was up
power, height and distance! That kept going and going....Dhoni down the track to a length ball and he slammed that into orbit over long-on, went several miles up in the air
punches it towards point and Tiwary needlessly fires the throw towards the stumps, it was wide and nobody backing up
full and wide outside off and driven wide of cover
tries to flick and he gets hit on the pads, not sure if there was an inside edge, could have missed leg, Illingworth not convinced
good running, Dhoni stays back and clips it wide of midwicket and charges off aiming to take a couple, Unadkat does the chasing and the throw was wide at the batsman's end
stays back and chops it wide of point
he goes for the slog and gets an inside edge that trickles past the stumps
skidded through and clipped wide of square leg
gets forward and drives wide of cover
he had to hurry there, cut wide of cover and Dhoni had to scamper the second, throw just wide of the bowler's stumps
stays beside the line and he steers it to third man, Nadeem slips, what's happening with the Daredevils fielders today?
aimed for the yorker but it was a low full toss clipped away to midwicket
Raina's caught by his former CSK team-mate, this was a length ball, Raina stayed at the crease and looked to clear long-on, didn't get the distance, Vijay takes the skier well in front of the rope
this was jammed full outside off, looks to dig it out
slower ball and he mistimes it to cover
too good for the boundary rider! This was too full and wide outside off, Faf shuffled a long way to meet the ball, placed wide of cover and the sweeper couldn't stop it
down leg and swept fine and Unadkat has to do the chasing again
fired full on the pads and he whips it to deep square leg and Unadkat dives and does well to save the boundary, he too looks to have hurt himself
this was fuller and flatter, he fetches that from outside off and pulls in front of square
he makes room and cuts him wide of cover
he makes room and drives him wide of cover
he stays back and knocks it to the off side
full outside the off stump and he squirts it wide of point and that's his fifty!
drifting down the leg side and nearly clipped the trouser on the way through
punches it to the off side and sets off, had to scamper because the throw to the bowler's end was wide
that's the line! Neesham bowls it on the corridor outside off and the ball shapes away late, fizzes past the edge
this one skidded through quickly and hit the back pad, looked like drifting down leg
slower ball and he deftly edges it to third man
missed out, he drills it back to the bowler
takes a single down to long-on
poor over this, Vijay strays down leg, fine leg leg was up, Raina sweeps fine and it's an easy boundary
a bit too short and he finds cover
back to back fours, this was tossed up outside off and he reaches out and drives wide of point and down to third man
Raina welcomes Vijay with a spanking cut wide of cover, dropped a bit too short
the arm ball gets him! From round the wicket, this one came back in with the arm. skidded through and hit the stumps, Smith was rooted to the crease, left a big gap
skids through and he shuffles and clips it wide of square leg
flatter one and he drills it down to long-on
tossed up on the pads and Raina gets on his knee early and slogs him behind square, deep square leg picks up
that was clean! Tossed up by Nadeem and Raina went down the track and took it downtown, the ball clears the straight boundary
he goes back and punches this to the off side
picks the vacant area, this was drifting on the pads, Raina shuffled across early and neatly chipped it over short fine leg
he comes down the track again and he chips this just over the bowler's head, but there was a short run
he comes down the track and lofts over extra cover
comes forward and he knocks it to the on side
this was drifting on middle and leg and he sweeps him firmly to deep square leg
this was flatter and shorter, he makes room and cuts him down to sweeper cover
Raina makes a bit of room and looks to smash that over the off side and he's beaten
worked away wide of square leg
this was driven to the front of mid-off and Raina really had to hurry, the throw was wide
this was drifting down the leg side, too short and he looked to pull
drifts on the pads and he looks to work it away, drops to the off side
that was flat, this was dropped fractionally short, Smith read the length early and pulled him flat over square leg, one bounce and over
Raina makes room to a fuller ball and drives but can't beat mid-off
tossed up and he comes forward and drives to long-off
makes a hint of room and Duminy follows him by drifting on the pads, he can only drive back to the bowler
flatter one and Raina is happy to defend
this was short and wide outside off, he makes room and cuts wide of point
missed out, this was short and Smith could only smack this back to Duminy
he rocks back and knocks it towards cover
on the pads and he works it wide of midwicket
shorter this time from Neesham and Raina angles this to third man
gives him width and he deliberately angles it down to third man, Unadkat does really well to keep it to a single
angles it across and he slices it wide of backward point
this was pitched up wide outside off, in Raina's hitting zone, lofts through the line and clears cover, long-on cannot cut it off
starts off with a full toss and Raina misses out, can only mistime it to short midwicket
slower ball on the pads and he works it to square leg
good slower all from round the wicket, he can only defend it to the on side, takes a run
makes room and steers it wide of point

confusion in the running, slower ball and Smith was too early on the pull, deflects off the body and rolls past the keeper, Parnell takes aim at the bowler's end and had it been a direct hit Smith would have been out
doesn't give him much room as he steers it to point
keeps it nice and straight, goes back and defends
Shami squares him up with beautiful away swing, this moves away late and Raina was chasing it
this was shorter and he swivels to pull but doesn't force it away, places it wide of square leg
this was a length ball on the off stump and he mistimes the pull, seen a few of those
didn't play that one very well, it was full and he manages to get his bat down and gets an outside edge to third man
he fires that full outside the off stump and he looks to jam it out but misses
swinging in on the middle stump and he knocks it towards mid-on
he makes a bit of room and he punches it square on the off side
this was full outside the off stump and he drills it down the ground to long-on
keeps him on the back foot this time as he pushes it to third man
he gets forward and steers it to point

okay forget about the drop! Daredevils make amends for it, McCullum dances down the track to Unadkat and looks to smash it over the on side, ends up getting an outside edge that loops wide of slip and goes to the substitute Parnell at short third man
JP Duminy drops a sitter! The dropped catches epidemic spreads, Length ball and McCullum chips it ever so tamely to short cover, Duminy had it covered, don't ask me how that slipped out
squared up for turn, he tamely pushes it to the off side
he rocks back and slaps it wide of cover but extra cover picks up
tossed up, invites McCullum to use his feet, comes down the pitch and lofts him over mid-off
this was drifting on the pads, he clips it away wide of short fine leg, McCullum slips as he completes the first run
once again looks to force it away and he mistimes it to mid-on
arm ball, this was drifting in from Nadeem and he looked to drive wide of cover but got an inside edge, close call
full and straying on the pads, clips the pads as he looks to flick it away
sped away quickly, this was too full and wide outside off, Smith gets across and smashes it along the turf wide of cover
fuller and towards the stumps and he whips it away wide of square leg
this one moves away and he pokes at it, nearly edges it
decent shout for an lbw? Straightens and hits him on the top flap as he stays on the back foot, looked close though, appeal turned down, the commentators reckoned that was hitting the stumps
this was the right length for Smith to pull, length ball a touch wide outside off, Smith fetches that and pulls along the ground wide of midwicket
tossed up and he pushes it back to the bowler
he rocks back and cuts but can't beat extra cover
this time McCullum gives the charge but he can only force it to mid-off
he goes back and works it to mid-on
tossed up and full, he comes forward and clips it to square leg
drifts down the leg side again and he pulls and finds fine leg
starts off with a wide down the leg side, Smith was looking to pull that

That's the game! Coulter-Nile will not bat, this was tossed up outside off and Nadeem made room to carve that over cover, Raina ran to his right at cover and took the catch easily at the edge of the circle
pushes it softly towards point and sets off
flatter one and he makes room and drives to deep cover
makes room to drive and he misses it
rocks back and cuts to point
looked like the one that straightened, Unadkat was squared up and beaten
quicker one and he gets forward to defend
round the wicket and fired that wide outside off

after two quick deliveries Ashwin tosses this one up ever so slowly, the point was to tempt Shami into going for the big hit and he does just that, played away from the body and he miscued it to McCullum at long-off
this was fired through again but on the stumps and defends
he fires this one wide down the leg side
flatter one and he whips it wide of square leg
straight to deep midwicket, Neesham attempts to slog that for a six over deep midwicket, fetches it from outside off, it went flat to Raina, seven down, can Daredevils at least reach 100?
skids through and he clips it towards midwicket for a couple
gets forward and punches it to long-off
skids through but he manages to clip it to the on side
stays back and punches it to the off side
pushes it with soft hands towards point and sets off
stays back and gets an outside edge to the off side
hit on the pads as he looks to sweep but it may have pitched outside leg
he gets forward and pushes it to mid-off
he comes forward and drives to the off side

One Chennai boy bowls another, Ashwin was bowling round the wicket, Karthik made a lot of room early on looking to push it to the off side, he may have expected turn but it went straight through and knocked the middle stump
back to back boundaries, this was dropped short and wide outside off, Neesham places it well wide of short third man and point, good placement and timing
they need plenty more of those, tossed up on middle and leg and he slogs him over midwicket
short outside off and he punches it wide of point

Karthik plays the reverse sweep and he plays it off the back of the bat, Dhoni meanwhile anticipates it well and quickly stretches his right leg and deflects the ball to short third man, clever footwork by MSD
flatter one and he's hit on the pads
gets an inside edge to the leg side and they run hard for the second
he steers it square of the wicket on the off side for a couple
full on the off stump and he drives him down to long-off
nicely played, the keeper was up, a hint of width, no slip and he gently steered this down to third man
full outside off and he drives down the ground to long-off
full outside off and he pushes at it and misses
short of a length and he stays back and defends
Karthik was trapped by the swing, this one moved away sharply and he flashed at it
this one swings away and he drives him wide of cover
gets good inswing to Neesham, he gets an inside edge to the on side
Hilfy gets the line and length spot on this time! The away swinger gets him, swung away from the middle stump, Taylor was compelled to  go for the drive, thick outside edge to Dhoni
that was a gift, friendly full toss on the pads, all he had to do was shuffle slightly and work it wide of the keeper
bowls from wide of the crease, full and driven to short cover and they take a quick single
punched towards backward point and they don't push the single
full in length outside the off stump and softly pushed to mid-off
this swings in quite sharply and clips his pads as he looks to clip it away
full and wide outside off and he drives him wide of backward point
Smith totally loses control of that and sprays it wide down leg
Smith's got the big wicket of Duminy first ball! Pitched on middle and leg, the ball skidded through and went on straight, Duminy was trapped on the back foot and plumb in front

not sure what happened there, he was looking to drive, the keeper was up and the ball lobbed off Dhoni's glove and dropped short of Ashwin at short third man, not sure if there was an edge, ashwin didn't really go for it
gives him some width and he angles him just wide of point and down to third man
good length on the stumps and he clips him wide of square leg
shorter ball outside off and he angles him down to third man
fullish outside off and he drives to Faf at short cover, slight fumble
Duminy looking scratchy again, another inside edge to the leg side
crashed that past the gap! This was on a good length wide outside off, slapped that wide if backward point
he gives him width and he chops it wide of backward point and they take three
stays beside the line and angles it down to third man
clips it to the leg side and it was racing away to long leg and Sharma did a fine job sliding to cut that off
good length outside the off stump and he cuts him down to third man
struck on the pads and the ball rolls to the off side
how many inside edges have we seen already? Fetches that from outside off, looks to drive straighter, edges past the stumps
nips back in and he opens the face of the bat and knocks it wide of slip
nearly dragged that onto his stumps!Fetches that from wide outside off and he gets an inside edge that rolls past the stumps
he comes round the wicket, width and he pushes at it and gets an outside edge to third man
he stays right back at the crease and knocks it to the off side and sets off
this was short and wide outside the off stump, he flashes and misses
this was moving away from him and he flashed at it
drifts down the leg side and surprisingly no wide called
that was a good shout for an lbw! Pitched on middle and was coming back in, Duminy trapped on the back foot, looked adjacent but may have been a tad high

Faf du Plessis is pulling off stunners out of habit tonight! Take a bow! Tiwary made a lot of room and charged down the track looking to clear the off side, unfortunately he made too much room and the ball spooned off the bottom of the bat, du Plessis ran backwards at mid-off and hung on on the dive just as the ball was leaving him, du Plessis covered a lot of ground getting to the ball, amazing stuff
this one moves away from him and he pokes his bat at it
close call for Karthik as he gets an inside edge that trickles past the stumps
chips down the track and he drives him to cover
nipped back in a bit too much and hit him high on the thigh pad, stifled appeal, Karthik was anyway yards out of his crease

Faf du Plessis has pulled off quite a stunner! Vijay looked to clear the straight boundary, it was high in the air and du Plessis was running back from mid-off, the running catches are the toughest, hung on to it and fell backwards
this one goes past the gap between bat and the pad, nips back in as he looks to drive, goes past the off stump
lovely use of the wrists! This was a half volley on the stumps, shuffles across the stumps, works the wrists and places it wide of midwicket
beaten outside off, Chennai's bowling has begun well here
dropped, pitched up this time, thick edge after the ball moves away, but that is put down by Ashwin at first slip, very tough low chance that
this time the ball cuts in, cramping up the batsman, who tucks the ball towards square leg
short of length ball is swatted to midwicket
back of a length ball, defended off the front foot to the off side

there have been plenty of dropped catches this season, but this time Raina takes a terrific catch, Mayank has flopped, a length ball and Mayank wanted to play that inside-out, bat turns as he plays that and the ball loops towards cover, Raina has some ground to cover, he sprints to his left and pouches that one
pushed towards mid-off for a single, just two off that Hilfenhaus over
good stuff from hilfenhaus, cutting away after pitching just outside off, too much movement for Mayank to deal with, he's beaten
defended behind point

Mayank wanted to smash that out of the park, he had decided even before the ball was delivered, Hilfenhaus drops it short and Mayank can't get anywhere near the ball as he half-heartedly attempts a slog
keeps it around off stump, a thick inside edge sends the ball towards midwicket for a single
pitched up by Hilfenhaus, defended towards point
keeps it close to off, guides this down towards third man
good riposte from Pandey, gets the ball to curl away outside off, past the outside edge
drops it short, Vijay lifts that on the up, good contact to launch that over cover, a couple of bounces before reaching the boundary
length ball this time, Vijay defends his first ball
a touch shorter, 134kph, slapped firmly towards point where a diving Raina keeps them to a single
starts with a short of length ball, defended to the off side
